nodes.title: RegisterConceptBodyDto's exported type requires description
nodes.summary: Widens RegisterConceptBodyDto's exported TypeScript type to state description as a required string, matching domain/glossary/concept, while leaving registerConceptBodySchema's runtime parsing of description untouched.

nodes.title: Description-required DTO widening — compile-time proof plus the runtime gap it left uncovered
nodes.summary: A new compile-time type-test file falsifies criterion 1 (and the ttl half of criterion 5) directly against RegisterConceptBodyDto, one new HTTP-level test closes the one runtime gap (an explicit empty-string description) no existing test exercised, and the rest of criteria 2-5 are already fully proven by pre-existing tests this delivery did not need to duplicate.

nodes.title: Review: RegisterConceptBodyDto's exported type requires description
nodes.summary: Coverage, specification conformance, standard conformance and failure diagnosis over require-description's delivered change against the current main tree.
unproven: A registration request carrying a non-empty description continues to validate and register exactly as it does today.

registerConceptBodySchema's runtime parsing of description is unchanged: a request body with the key absent, or with an empty-string value, still passes safeParse and reaches the controller and service exactly as it does today.
